
```{devoirs_choices dot_product_16_two_choices}

- An arithmetic operation on two vectors used to calculate their directional alignment.:
    correct: true

- The product of the two vector lengths, regardless of their directions.:

- A coordinate that identifies a point in the input space.:
    correct: false
```
